{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# Licensed to the Apache Software Foundation (ASF) under one

name: JavaScript

env:
  DEBUG: napi:*
  APP_NAME: adbc-driver-manager
  MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET: '10.15'
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: '1'

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'javascript/**'
      - 'rust/**'
      - '.github/workflows/javascript.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'javascript/**'
      - 'rust/**'
      - '.github/workflows/javascript.yml'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: javascript/package-lock.json
      - name: Cache Cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('javascript/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Use stable Rust
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --no-self-update
          rustup default stable
          rustup component add clippy rustfmt
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm ci
      - name: Verify package-lock.json is up to date
        working-directory: javascript
        run: |
          npm install --package-lock-only
          git diff --exit-code package-lock.json
      - name: Check JS
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm run check:js
      - name: Check Rust
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm run check:rust

  build:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        settings:
          - host: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - host: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - host: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - host: windows-11-arm
            target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
          - host: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - host: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
    name: Build Node.js ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.settings.host }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: javascript/package-lock.json
      - name: Cache Cargo dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-${{ hashFiles('javascript/Cargo.lock') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-
      - name: Use stable Rust
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install stable --no-self-update
          rustup default stable
          rustup target add ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm ci
      - name: Build
        working-directory: javascript
        shell: bash
        run: npm run build:ci -- --target ${{ matrix.settings.target }} && npm run build:ts
      - name: Ad-hoc sign binary (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        working-directory: javascript
        run: codesign --sign - *.node
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: bindings-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          path: javascript/*.node
          if-no-files-found: error

  test:
    name: Test ${{ matrix.settings.target }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: build
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.settings.host }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        settings:
          - host: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - host: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
          - host: macos-15-intel
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
          - host: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
          - host: windows-latest
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
          - host: windows-11-arm
            target: aarch64-pc-windows-msvc
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Setup node
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: javascript/package-lock.json
      - name: Install dependencies
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm ci --omit=optional
      - name: Download artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: bindings-${{ matrix.settings.target }}
          path: javascript
      - name: Install C++ dependencies (Windows)
        # SQLite is the only dependency the test driver build needs, so take
        # it from the runner's preinstalled vcpkg (present on both the x64 and
        # arm64 images) rather than conda. The static-md triplet links SQLite
        # into the driver DLL, so nothing extra has to go on PATH at runtime.
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $triplet = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') { 'arm64-windows-static-md' } else { 'x64-windows-static-md' }
          & "$env:VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT\vcpkg.exe" install "sqlite3:$triplet"
          $toolchain = "$env:VCPKG_INSTALLATION_ROOT\scripts\buildsystems\vcpkg.cmake" -replace '\\', '/'
          echo "ADBC_CMAKE_ARGS=-DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=$toolchain -DVCPKG_TARGET_TRIPLET=$triplet" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Install C++ dependencies (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get install libsqlite3-dev
      - name: Build Driver
        # We need to build the SQLite driver for tests.
        shell: bash
        run: ci/scripts/node_build.sh "${{ github.workspace }}/javascript/build"
      - name: Set driver path (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: echo "ADBC_DRIVER_MANAGER_TEST_LIB=${{ github.workspace }}/javascript/build/lib/libadbc_driver_sqlite.so" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Set driver path (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: echo "ADBC_DRIVER_MANAGER_TEST_LIB=${{ github.workspace }}/javascript/build/lib/libadbc_driver_sqlite.dylib" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Set driver path (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          echo "PATH=${{ github.workspace }}/javascript/build/bin;$env:PATH" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          echo "ADBC_DRIVER_MANAGER_TEST_LIB=${{ github.workspace }}/javascript/build/bin/adbc_driver_sqlite.dll" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      - name: Run Tests
        working-directory: javascript
        run: npm test
",
  "rationale": "Add Cargo dependency caching (registry and git) to the lint and build jobs. The workflow already caches npm dependencies via setup-node, but Cargo dependencies were not cached. Each build job runs Cargo to compile native code, and the lint job also runs Rust checks. Caching the Cargo registry avoids repeated downloads across runs and matrix configurations. This optimization is supported by pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) which reports modest aggregate benefit, and by a measured experiment (P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) showing ~9% elapsed time savings when adding a dependency cache step. Preconditions are met: repeated dependency fetching is measurable (Cargo runs in every build job), and cache inputs include a lockfile (Cargo.lock) and environment (runner OS). The change preserves all build and test coverage and does not weaken permissions or add privileged actions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
